test_case.test_name: Fully populated system 100 AC cycles at 0C/+5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify all populated devices and services recover through 100 complete AC OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready cycles at cold/high-rail margin without unexpected events or loss.
required_package: Rated interlocked AC fixture and dwell/readiness profile
Per-cycle event/device oracle and abort/recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/+5% conditions and execute exactly 100 approved fixture cycles, proving true off/discharge, reapplication, POST/BMC/OS readiness and full inventory on every cycle, then warm dry and restore nominal state.
test_case.expected_result: All 100 entries complete the defined power transitions and deadlines with complete inventory, expected-only events and no hang or unrecovered service fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires 100 distinct OFF→ON→OS-ready records plus per-cycle inventory/events; final boot only, DC reset, warm reboot or silent retry cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified chamber/high-rail operator and OOB visibility
Preserve logs; abort on electrical, moisture, boot or device fault
No auto-retry; warm above dew point before access
expected_evidence: Per-cycle inventory/event deltas, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: On first disallowed fault stop cycling, preserve the failed entry, isolate power safely, restore nominal rails, warm/dry, recover affected devices/services and do not retry automatically.

blocked.reason: A safe parameterized manual cycle contract is defined.
